name: WPRuby UPS Shipping for WooCommerce
author: Waseem Senjer

sections.description:
Show live UPS rates and delivery times at checkout. The plugin connects to the UPS REST Rating API with OAuth 2.0 and rates all the items in a cart as one multi-piece UPS shipment.

  • US domestic services: Ground, 3 Day Select, 2nd Day Air, 2nd Day Air AM, Next Day Air, Next Day Air Saver and Next Day Air Early AM.
  • International services: Standard, Saver, Worldwide Express, Worldwide Express Plus, Worldwide Expedited and Express 12:00.
  • Choose the services and a handling fee (amount or percentage) for each shipping zone.
  • UPS Center (WooCommerce > UPS Center): connect your UPS account, test the connection, set a ship-from address, and run Shipping Health checks for your setup and products.

Need UPS labels from your orders, negotiated rates, SurePost or custom boxes? See UPS Shipping Method Pro.

Disclaimer: This plugin is created and maintained by WPRuby.com using the publicly available API of UPS (United Parcel Service, Inc.) and WooCommerce. All product names, trademarks and registered trademarks are property of their respective owners.
sections.installation:
Uploading in WordPress Dashboard

  1. Navigate to the ‘Add New’ in the plugins dashboard
  2. Navigate to the ‘Upload’ area
  3. Select wc-ups-shipping-method.zip from your computer
  4. Click ‘Install Now’
  5. Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard

Using FTP

  1. Download wc-ups-shipping-method.zip
  2. Extract the wc-ups-shipping-method directory to your computer
  3. Upload the wc-ups-shipping-method directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  4. Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard
sections.faq:
How do I get UPS API credentials?

  1. Sign in at https://developer.ups.com/ with your UPS account.
  2. Create an app and add the Rating API to it.
  3. Copy the app’s Client ID and Client Secret into WooCommerce > UPS Center > Settings.
  4. Enter your UPS account (shipper) number as well to get the rates for your account.

I used an Access Key before. What do I need to do?

UPS no longer accepts Access Key credentials. Create an app in the UPS Developer Portal as above and enter its Client ID and Client Secret in the UPS Center. Until then the plugin shows a notice in the admin and no UPS rates at checkout.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Changed: The plugin is now called WPRuby UPS Shipping for WooCommerce.
  • Fixed: One-day delivery estimates read “1 day” instead of “1 days”.
  • Changed: New plugin icon, banner and screenshots.

1.1.0

  • Changed: Connect to UPS with OAuth 2.0 and the UPS REST Rating API. UPS has retired Access Key authentication, so enter a Client ID and Client Secret from the UPS Developer Portal. Stores that still have an Access Key saved see a notice.
  • Added: UPS Center (WooCommerce > UPS Center) with Settings, Shipping Health and Pro Features tabs, and a connection status and Test Connection in the header.
  • Added: Ship-from address setting, for when parcels leave from somewhere other than the store address.
  • Changed: Redesigned the UPS settings in each shipping zone: settings in cards, services as checkable cards with descriptions, units next to the weight and size, a live example of the handling fee, and warnings when UPS is not connected or no service can return a rate.
  • Fixed: Invalid handling fees, weights and sizes are rejected with a message instead of being saved.
  • Added: Shipping Health checks for credentials, UPS connectivity, the account number, ship-from address, shipping zones, products missing weights or dimensions, debug mode and versions.
  • Changed: All packages in a cart are rated together as one multi-piece UPS shipment, with full origin and destination addresses.
  • Changed: Rates are shopped across all enabled services. International services can be offered to US addresses for stores outside the US.
  • Fixed: Weights and dimensions are sent in pounds and inches for US and Puerto Rico origins, and in kilograms and centimetres elsewhere.
  • Fixed: Debug mode now applies to the UPS shipping method.
  • Fixed: Items too large for the default box are rated as their own packages instead of returning no rates.
  • Added: High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) compatibility declaration.
  • Changed: Requires WordPress 6.2, WooCommerce 8.2 and PHP 7.4. Tested up to WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.3.
  • Changed: The plugin steps aside while UPS Shipping Method Pro is active.

1.0.3

  • Added: WordPress 6.3 compatibility.

1.0.2

  • Added: Documentation and Support links in the settings page.

1.0.1

  • Fixed: increase height of default dimensions fields.

1.0

  • Initial release.
